soru: How many times had Tara performed in eleven months?
tr: Tara on bir ayda kaç kez sahneye çıkmıştı?
kanit: she had never once stepped onto the stage.

soru: What advice did the director give?
secenekler: Don't try to be Margaret; just be loud
kanit: Don't try to be Margaret. Nobody can be Margaret. Just be very, very loud.

soru: How did the audience react at the end?
secenekler: They asked for their money back
kanit: Then the applause started. It went on, and on, and people began to stand up.

soru: What does Tara do for her own understudy?
secenekler: Makes sure she performs at least once a week
kanit: Every week, she made sure her own understudy got at least one chance to perform.
For eleven months, Tara had been the understudy for the role of Lady Macbeth at the Royal Crown Theatre.
